protocol.scope: 100 large U.S. and territory airports; reporting-carrier domestic events
protocol.selection: Fixed v3 airport-local regularized logistic heads, independent probability calibration and 80% empirical outcome-rate band calibration. All three variants share identical eligible rows within each airport/direction/horizon. Original production weather models are preserved separately.
protocol.calibration: Retain v2 calibration for incumbent airports. Each added airport fits its own sigmoid on model log odds with C=0.02, using only that airport probability-calibration outcomes; no class rebalancing.
protocol.interval: Central signed-residual 80% empirical band from nine months; airport plus predicted-risk bins (<25%,25-50%,50%+) with >=100 windows, otherwise airport fallback. No guarantee under temporal dependence.
protocol.evidence: Moderate requires sample support, positive 95% Brier-skill interval, BH-adjusted approximate bootstrap q <= 0.1 across all tested airport/direction/horizon comparisons within the evaluation period, calibration error <5pp, and band coverage >=75%.
protocol.fairHorizonComparison: Fit and evaluate each horizon on its eligible windows; matched-window results reported separately. Missing 24-hour forecasts do not discard 6/12-hour examples.
limitations: January-February 2026 was not loaded or evaluated in v1, but evaluates winter only
March-June 2026 has been inspected in v1 and is a disclosed stress re-evaluation, never a new holdout
Candidate development validation overlaps the final probability calibration period; final interval calibration and fresh test remain outside selection
Final-vintage BTS outcomes; no release-vintage reconstruction or cancellation announcement time
TAF issue/product time plus lag approximates historical delivery
No private or global flight-outcome transfer
Winter 2026 is retrospective: these dates and some connected flight outcomes were inspected in earlier versions; no new independent prospective accuracy claim
Some catalog airports lack covered domestic passenger outcomes or supported forecast products
protocol.eligibilityDecision: Before fitting or viewing 2026 results: first training-month audit showed a ten-flight minimum excluded many smaller airports. Use all known-outcome windows and flight-count weighting; preserve fit/calibration/test support gates and report empirical band coverage. Incumbent v2 models retain their original ten-flight cohorts.

operationsProtocol.question: Does recent FAA advisory activity improve airport-local weather forecasts across all 100 major U.S. airports in the current study?
operationsProtocol.scope: All 100 airports in the source protocol, including U.S. territories. Each airport learns only from its own reporting-carrier scheduled domestic outcomes. Medium/private airports without flight outcomes receive context, not transferred probabilities.
operationsProtocol.faaRule: Use the shared historical/live extractor. At a forecast cutoff, use publication timestamps no later than the preceding hourly collection at :35 minus 10 minutes. Count exact airport GS/GDP issue/revision/cancellation messages in the preceding 6/24 hours. Never use future effective starts, observations, flight outcomes, or volume as predictors. Full date coverage is required. A missing archive day is unknown. PBI is explicitly mapped to the current DJT outcome identifier.
operationsProtocol.sourceReuse: Reparse the 903 complete national FAA daily listings cached by operations-pilot-v1 for every airport. Preserve the 30 missing/ambiguous dates. No new historical downloads and no runway feature requirement.
operationsProtocol.learner: Fixed v3 airport-local regularized logistic heads, independent probability calibration and 80% empirical outcome-rate band calibration. All three variants share identical eligible rows within each airport/direction/horizon. Original production weather models are preserved separately.
operationsProtocol.primaryMetric: Paired flight-event-weighted disruption Brier error: operations versus matched weather baseline.
operationsProtocol.uncertainty: 1000 paired three-day calendar-block bootstrap draws. BH adjustment across all tested operations-versus-weather slices separately for each period. Aggregates share sampled calendar blocks across airports. Descriptive aggregate intervals are not multiplicity adjusted. Different horizons retain different eligible windows.
operationsProtocol.testDisclosure: Both 2026 periods and the six pilot airports were previously inspected. This is a retrospective nationwide expansion following an encouraging pilot, not a pristine confirmatory test. Do not tune on these outcomes or hide regressions.
operationsProtocol.serving: An explicitly experimental operations model may be compared with the existing weather model. Require local fit/calibration/test support, supported local hours, fresh complete FAA history, a complete fresh TAF window, and matching feature versions. Expose missing FAA history as unavailable, never silently zero. Evidence labels use the winter operations-versus-weather comparison and downgrade out-of-range inputs. Sparse or absent FAA messages are disclosed; no claim of private-jet accuracy or comprehensive congestion/ATC coverage.

budget.rule: Fit locally from existing cached data. Live shared national advisory collection is bounded and must fit existing compute, early-stop, lease, storage, and dollar safeguards. No browser-triggered provider requests or training.
